name: Disco Inferno
description: '''Disco Inferno''' were an English [[experimental rock]] band. Initially a trio performing in a conventional [[post-punk]] style, the band soon began to prominently incorporate [[Sampling (music)|digital sampling]], drawing from various audio sources and pairing it with atmospheric, hypnotic songwriting. Despite being commercially unsuccessful while active, the band later acquired a [[cult following]], with critics later regarding them as a key act in the [[Post-rock#1990s: first wave|first wave of post-rock]].
